description: Run delegated work across three layers — strategy, management, execution: size the task, pick a delegation architecture, and dispatch scoped slices to model-tiered agents (scout, builder, reviewer, manager). Skills cover orchestration, session handoff, backlog waves, and a review cycle (rubric-panel, deletion-pass, comment-hygiene, layer-cycle) whose refine phase is the cleanup step that runs before work lands. Hooks watch context watermarks, guard handoff freshness, surface the handoff on cold start, log delegation tier usage, nudge on retained-labor streaks, flag history left in comments at the moment of a commit or a PR, brief workers on the delegation covenant, give writing workers their own git worktree, and hold protected config in custody per project. The /atelier:activate command arms all of that in a project and reports in plain language what each hook actually resolved.
name: atelier
